target.subtext: ₹1,00,000 of new monthly recurring revenue is four retainers at ₹25,000. At a 25% close rate that needs 16 proposals. Over a quarter that is 5–6 proposals a month, or one qualified conversation every three days.

strategies.title: Upsell what you already have
strategies.desc: Thirteen live clients on one service line each. A digital marketing client never offered SEO or SAG·EO is the easiest sale in the business — no pitching, no trust-building, no acquisition cost. Two upsell conversations a month.

strategies.title: Own the wellness vertical
strategies.desc: Susrutha, Pranalaya, Ayushi. Three Ayurveda and wellness clients is not coincidence, it is a specialism with proof. 'We run digital for Ayurveda hospitals in Kerala' beats 'we do digital marketing', and it lets you charge more.

strategies.title: BNI, used properly
strategies.desc: You are Social Media Coordinator at Matrix — a room of business owners who see your work weekly. One structured one-to-one a week with someone you have never pitched.

strategies.title: Referrals, asked for on a schedule
strategies.desc: Every client who says something positive gets asked the same day who else you should be talking to. Most agencies never ask.

strategies.title: Cold outreach, narrow only
strategies.desc: Into verticals where you hold a case study — education after iLearn, real estate after Masters, interiors after Perfect Interior. Never generic.

assetSteps.title: One month of payroll in reserve
assetSteps.desc: ₹2.4 lakh, separate account, untouched. This is the first asset and the one that ends the cycle of pledging gold to make salaries.

assetSteps.title: Clear the 40% debt
assetSteps.desc: Paying off a card returns 40% guaranteed. No investment available to you beats that.

assetSteps.title: Three months of expenses
assetSteps.desc: ₹11.5 lakh. The business now survives a bad quarter without you funding it personally.

assetSteps.title: Systematic investing, small and automatic
assetSteps.desc: ₹10,000 a month on a standing instruction. The amount is irrelevant; the habit and the date are the point.

assetSteps.title: Property proceeds, deployed to a plan written before the money lands
assetSteps.desc: Liabilities, buffer, Section 54 reinvestment, then growth. Money that arrives without a plan gets spent.

assetSteps.title: Three income sources
assetSteps.desc: Services, products, capital. That is what makes wealth durable rather than a good year.
